full.source_equivalence: Application/test/tools and full CI workflow match focused commit

source_identity: Every supplied file matches SHA256, Git blob and exact tested commit

evidence_levels.E2: Production Global/Project registry with actual owned Windows subprocesses, temporary files, pipes, ArtifactStore and journal; model transport scripted
evidence_levels.E3: NOT_RUN; native GUI not required by AR-040 process acceptance; AR-020/033 remain pending

historical_failures.cause: Conflicting shell namespace metadata blocked production composition
Exact-output fixture also received native PowerShell progress; production stderr was not stripped

limits: CancelOnHostExit, not a surviving worker. No PID adoption or automatic uncertain-write replay.
Full-access-only shell is not a filesystem/network sandbox. No elevation or access to another task/process.
Retained output is capped at 1000000 UTF-16 characters per stream; truncation is explicit. Exit zero proves process exit, not arbitrary user-goal semantics.
No E3/E4 native Office/model/UI acceptance, E5 NAS certification or MB-124–127 closure.
